Last release: @thoth-agents/pi-subagents@0.16.0
Target ref: @thoth-agents/pi-subagents@0.17.0

## Core
### Improvements

- `ac76229` feat(pi-subagents): show and edit fallback model chains in /subagents-model
- `e9543a0` feat(pi-core,pi-subagents): keep narrow subagent Work panel entries to two rows
- `372caea` feat(pi-core,pi-subagents): treat provider-native tools in flight as active
- `43bb224` feat(pi-subagents): raise default subagent timeout_ms to 30 minutes
- `e42059c` feat(pi-subagents): opt-in model fallback chains for subagents

### Bugfixes

- `16e3043` fix(pi): restore overlay typecheck and Work panel CI coverage
- `e94f344` fix(pi-subagents): drop 'agent settled' row once the attempt yields its final response
- `9c60784` fix(pi-subagents): stop false tool_failure after post-turn compaction
